entries.content: 恢复科学：睡眠7-9小时（记忆巩固+肌肉修复）、蛋白质1.6-2.2g/kg/天、水35ml/kg、休息日每周1-2次。没有恢复无法训练—过度训练导致疲劳、免疫力下降、失眠。
回復科学：睡眠7-9時間（記憶定着+筋肉修復）、タンパク質1.6-2.2g/kg/日、水35ml/kg、休息日週1-2回。回復なしにトレーニングできない—オーバートレーニング疲労、免疫力低下、不眠症原因。

Recovery science: sleep 7-9 hours (memory consolidation + muscle repair), protein 1.6-2.2g/kg/day, water 35ml/kg, rest day 1-2x/week. Cannot train without recovery — overtraining causes fatigue, reduced immunity, insomnia.

Recovery science: sleep 7-9 hours (memory consolidation + muscle repair), protein 1.6-2.2g/kg/ngày, nước 35ml/kg, rest day 1-2x/week. Không training without recovery — overtraining gây thể thống, giảm immunity, insomnia.
复合动作：深蹲、硬拉、卧推、引体向上、俯卧撑、划船。多关节运动，建立基础力量，激素反应比孤立运动好。开始：Starting Strength（深蹲/卧推/硬拉每周3次）或StrongLifts 5x5。
複合運動：スクワット、デッドリフト、ベンチプレス、懸垂、腕立て伏せ、ロー。多関節運動、基礎筋力構築、ホルモン反応アイソレーションより良い。開始：Starting Strength（スクワット/ベンチ/デッドリフト週3回）またはStrongLifts 5x5。

Compound exercises: squat, deadlift, bench press, pull-up, push-up, rows. Multi-joint movements, build foundation strength, better hormone response than isolation. Starting: Starting Strength (Squat/Bench/Deadlift 3x/week) or StrongLifts 5x5.

Compound exercises: squat, deadlift, bench press, pull-up, push-up, rows. Multi-joint movements, build foundation strength, hormone response tốt hơn isolation. Bắt đầu: Starting Strength (Squat/Bench/Deadlift 3x/week) or StrongLifts 5x5.
渐进超负荷：逐渐增加负荷（重量、次数、组数、强度）。每周5-10%。不要突然增加。方法：增加重量、增加次数、增加组数、减少休息时间、改善姿势。教训：一致性 > 强度。
進行性過負荷：徐々に負荷を増やす（重量、回数、セット、強度）。毎週5-10%。突然増やさない。方法：重量増加、回数増加、セット増加、休憩時間減少、フォーム改善。教訓：継続性＞強度。

Progressive overload: gradually increase load (weight, reps, sets, intensity). 5-10% each week. Don't increase suddenly. Methods: increase weight, increase reps, increase sets, reduce rest time, improve form. Lesson: consistency > intensity.

Progressive overload: tăng dần load (weight, reps, sets, intensity). 5-10% mỗi tuần. Không tăng đột ngột. Phương pháp: tăng weight, tăng reps, tăng sets, giảm rest time, cải thiện form. Lesson: consistency > intensity.
